offering_description.value: Insures condominium associations, homeowners associations and apartment property owners, primarily in Florida. Its insurance subsidiary underwrites the policies and distributes them through a managing general agent and insurance brokers.

primary_products.value: commercial property insurance policies for condominiums, homeowners associations and apartment buildings

customer_segment.value: B2B: condominium associations, homeowners associations and apartment property owners

end_markets.value: commercial residential real estate; community associations

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: premiums for commercial property coverage

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: pools premiums and assumes property risk for community associations and apartment owners

specialization.value: niche specialist: commercial residential property insurance for associations and apartment buildings

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: a managing general agent and independent commercial insurance brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Florida Office of Insurance Regulation oversight of insurer licensing, solvency and property insurance filings

notes: Florida is its core market, and any recent expansion beyond Florida is uncertain.
